SELECT
    m.CSNAME AS `股票名称`,
    m.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`,
    v.F001D AS `财政周期结束日期`,
    v.F005V AS `货币`,
    v.F006V AS `地域英文`,
    v.REGION_CNAME AS `地域中文`,
    ROUND(v.F007N / 100, 3) AS `销售收入/亿`,
    v.F008N AS `运营收入（百万美元）`
FROM
    AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN m
INNER JOIN
    VIEW_COM3106 v ON m.FIU_ID = v.FIU_ID
WHERE
    m.COMB_SYMBOL = 'GOOGL.US'
    AND (v.F006V LIKE '%North America%' OR v.REGION_CNAME LIKE '%北美%')
    AND v.F001D >= '2025-01-01'
    AND v.F001D < '2026-01-01'
    AND v.F007N IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    v.F001D DESC
LIMIT 1
